message: Every committed executor record under .engine/executors/ must satisfy executor-qualification.v1. A record that fails this — a bad or missing gate, a missing bridge/vendored-agent identity, a scope other than 'non-production', or a witness missing its scenario — is a malformed qualification or fail-closed witness, and the eligibility path must never read one. This is a schema-kind rule, so it inherits the schema kind's proven bite; fix the record to match the schema, or the schema if the record is right.
